description: Create the monster package foundation: config.py (settings, wordlists, regex patterns, API key management), utils.py (shared HTTP helpers with rate limiting, DNS utilities, colored output, file I/O, thread-safe operations), wordlists/subdomains.txt (top 1000 subdomain wordlist), __init__.py (package init with version), and __main__.py (CLI entry point that delegates to main.py). This establishes the shared infrastructure all other modules depend on.
steps: Create /projects/sandbox/Bug-Bounty/monster/__init__.py with version string '1.0.0' and brief docstring

Create /projects/sandbox/Bug-Bounty/monster/config.py with: DEFAULT_USER_AGENT, RATE_LIMIT_DELAY (1.0s default), MAX_THREADS (10), TIMEOUT (10s), common web ports list [80,443,8080,8443,3000,5000,9090], regex patterns for secrets (AWS keys, Firebase configs, Stripe keys, API tokens, JWTs, private keys, generic passwords), subdomain takeover fingerprints (S3, Heroku, GitHub Pages, Azure, Shopify, Fastly, Pantheon, Tumblr, etc. with their CNAME patterns and response body fingerprints), SECURITY_HEADERS list, CORS_TEST_ORIGINS, Google dork templates, Shodan query templates, technology fingerprint signatures (mapping response headers/body patterns to tech names), API key config loader (reads from env vars or ~/.monster/config.json)

Create /projects/sandbox/Bug-Bounty/monster/utils.py with: HTTPClient class (urllib-based with User-Agent, timeout, rate limiting via time.sleep, retry logic, SSL context handling, response caching), DNSResolver class (socket.getaddrinfo based + subprocess dig fallback for record types), ColorOutput class (wraps colorama with [MONSTER], [+], [!], [*], [-] prefixes and severity colors), FileManager class (create output dirs, save JSON/HTML/MD files, atomic writes), ThreadPool helper (concurrent.futures.ThreadPoolExecutor wrapper with progress tracking), RateLimiter (token bucket or simple delay-based), domain_from_url() helper, is_ip() helper, normalize_url() helper
